mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_contents (post_id, content_type, content_value, sequence) VALUES (#{post_id}, #{content.type}, #{content.value}, #{content.sequence})
INSERT INTO post_tags (post_id, lang_code, tag_name) VALUES (#{post_id}, #{tag.langCode}, #{tag.tagName})

INSERT INTO time_slots (slot_id, schedule_id, available_time, status, max_capacity, booked_count) VALUES (#{slot.id}, #{scheduleId}, #{slot.time}, #{slot.status}, IF(#{slot.maxCapacity} > 0, #{slot.maxCapacity}, 10), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, user_id, title, subtitle, price, discount_rate, duration, max_participants, rating, review_count, like_count, city_name, country, lat, lng, created_at, updated_at FROM posts WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT image_url FROM post_images WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY image_id ASC
SELECT content_type AS type, content_value AS value, sequence FROM post_contents WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY sequence ASC
SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, available_date AS date FROM post_schedules WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY available_date ASC
SELECT slot_id AS id, available_time AS time, status, max_capacity AS maxCapacity, booked_count AS bookedCount FROM time_slots WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY available_time ASC
